The National | Canadians honour their veterans

Nov. 11, 2026 | Canadians mark Remembrance Day with tributes to soldiers past and present, including those lost and injured in the fire at CFB Wainwright. A Quebec pilot dies during an honorary formation flight. And, authorities move against Ryan Wedding's alleged money launderers.
